verdict.rationale: Orrick publicly states that one offering, its Global Employment & Equity Compensation Solutions group, is delivered 'all on a fixed-fee basis'. That is a published alternative fee arrangement, but it covers only one practice, and the pack shows no firm-wide disclosure of how engagements are priced. Missing for 10: published rate structures or hourly-rate ranges, firm-wide AFA or billing-practice policy, fixed-fee details such as amounts or scope, and independent corroboration of pricing transparency.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm states publicly how engagements are priced — rate structures, alternative fee arrangements, or billing practices — rather than leaving cost entirely opaque

citations.quote: solutions that drive uniformity across jurisdictions – all on a fixed-fee basis
